scenarios.situation: The provider accepted the outbound dial request, but there is not yet authoritative evidence that the destination rang or answered.
must: report only that the call attempt was accepted or started
keep connection and task completion unresolved until authoritative state exists
mustNot: say the recipient answered
say the task completed
treat provider acceptance as proof of a conversation

scenarios.situation: Authoritative call state says the destination was not answered after the outbound attempt.
must: report the call as unanswered or no-answer
preserve the delegated task as incomplete unless another authoritative outcome completed it
require a deliberate newly authorized effect before any later retry
mustNot: call the outcome a provider failure without evidence
claim a human deliberately declined the call
automatically redial

scenarios.situation: Authoritative call state reports declined or rejected, but does not establish whether a human, device, screening layer, carrier, or policy caused it.
must: report the exact declined or rejected outcome
avoid inventing who or what caused the decline
keep the semantic task incomplete unless it completed through another authoritative path
mustNot: rewrite the outcome as generic infrastructure failure
say the recipient personally pressed decline without evidence
automatically retry

scenarios.situation: Authoritative provider or transport state says the outbound call failed before a conversation was established.
must: report a technical provider or transport call failure
keep the delegated task uncompleted
avoid attributing the failure to recipient choice
mustNot: report no-answer merely because no conversation happened
report that the recipient declined
claim the task failed semantically when another work path may remain

scenarios.situation: The call connected and Concierge spoke with the restaurant, but the line disconnected before the reservation was confirmed.
must: report that the call connected but the reservation remains incomplete or blocked
separate the known transport outcome from the unresolved semantic task outcome
continue or disposition surviving work through the normal native closed-loop path
mustNot: treat connection as reservation success
treat hangup as task completion
invent a confirmation that was never obtained

scenarios.situation: The outbound call response was lost after the carrier may already have accepted or progressed the attempt, and authoritative terminal state is not yet known.
must: classify the effect as uncertain rather than failed unanswered declined connected or completed
reconcile authoritative state before deciding what happened
reuse the same operation identity for an identical retry of the uncertain intended effect
mustNot: generate a fresh operation ID and blindly dial again
tell the owner the call failed solely because the response was lost
collapse uncertainty into no-answer

scenarios.situation: Concierge reaches voicemail and leaves an authorized message asking the restaurant to call back about a reservation.
must: report that voicemail was reached and a message was left
keep the reservation task pending unless leaving the message itself was the requested objective
use native defer recheck or callback semantics for surviving work
mustNot: call the reservation completed
treat voicemail as an asynchronous voice note
fall back to SMS or MMS
